item.tib: yi dam dbal phur gyi tshogs 'khor bsnyen sgrub las gsum srung zlog bcas kyi zin bris rnams phyogs gcig bsgrigs pa 'dod 'byung dbyig bzang
item.coloph: ces sogs kho bos bsgrigs par bya ba'i phyag bzhes zin ris sogs dam pa'i zhal byang rnams su lugs mang bgrangs 'dug pa de bzhin nyams su len bde ru/ mkhan ming pranyaja d+hi laM bdag gis rang dang rang 'dra rnams la phan blo dang / don gnyer slob 'bang 'ga' nas bskul ngor g.yung gling bla brang rtse nas/ smras pa/ de ltar rje btsun mkhas grub gong ma yi/ phyag len ma nor shing rta'i 'gros bzang gis/ drangs pa'i tog gzig nyin byed dbang po yis/ ngo mtshar lam gyi pad mo rnam par bzhed/ dam pas mdzad la bskyar zlos dgos dben kyang*/ rang 'dra'i nor dang blo gros kyis dben rnams/ le'u 'thor sna mang 'tshogs pa'i skabs dben phyir/ phyogs gcig bsgrig 'di kho bo thos dben pas/ rang 'dra rang dman rnams la phan pa'i sems/ lhag par brel kyang (yang) blo mig dog skyon gyis/ bslad srid yi dam lha dang mkhas rnams drung*/ 'chag po dge ba bstan 'gro'i dpal gyur cig/
